info.title: SMS Forwarding Device API
info.description: The ESP32-C3 management API. All routes require HTTP Basic Auth. The API uses plain HTTP on a trusted network.

servers.description: Local mock server. The Compose LAN service disables authentication.

x-requestLimits.description: Limits are enforced before authentication. Rejections use 414, 431, or 413 with Connection: close and Cache-Control: no-store. Fields must contain valid UTF-8 text and stay within their byte limits; rejections leave state unchanged and put only the field name in detail.

x-espIdfMigration.description: Signed, replay-protected OTA is available. Legacy plaintext import and raw OTA routes are not exposed.

x-apProvisioning.description: These exceptions apply only when the accepted TCP socket's local address is the provisioning AP address. APSTA requests received on the STA address use normal Basic authentication and X-CSRF-Token checks.

get.summary: Get non-secret cellular CA status for the saved keepalive URL
get.description: No query keys are accepted, the request body must be empty, and any Transfer-Encoding header is rejected. This dedicated target uses saved kaUrl, not a push channel. A URL or configuration change invalidates the probe session. Installed roots are shared only by canonical HTTPS origin.

200.description: Configured state and SHA-256 only; no certificate DER or origin is returned.

post.summary: Probe the saved keepalive URL TLS chain over WiFi
post.description: Runs a strict bundle-authenticated TLS handshake with SNI and hostname verification. No query keys are accepted, the request body must be empty, and any Transfer-Encoding header is rejected. It sends no HTTP request. The terminal GET /api/jobs result contains only a one-time 128-bit nonce and bounded leaf-first certificate hashes, issuer Name DER, and authority-key identifiers. This dedicated target uses saved kaUrl, not a push channel. A URL or configuration change invalidates the probe session. Installed roots are shared only by canonical HTTPS origin.

400.description: The channel or empty-body contract is invalid.

409.description: WiFi is unavailable or the channel already has an active CA job.

429.description: The bounded job queue is full.

post.summary: Validate and install the keepalive origin root CA
post.description: Consumes the nonce on the first attempt. nonce is the only query key. The request requires exact Content-Type application/pkix-cert, an explicit decimal Content-Length matching the body, and no Transfer-Encoding header. The device requires the candidate DER hash in its build-time ESP-IDF bundle allowlist, BasicConstraints CA=true, keyCertSign when a KeyUsage extension is present, a current self-signed certificate, an unchanged configuration generation, and a complete hostname-valid path for the retained peer chain. This dedicated target uses saved kaUrl, not a push channel. A URL or configuration change invalidates the probe session. Installed roots are shared only by canonical HTTPS origin.

400.description: The channel, nonce, or body is invalid.

409.description: The channel already has an active CA job.

429.description: The bounded job queue is full.

get.summary: Read saved keepalive settings and current job progress

200.description: Cached progress and preflight readiness; no traffic is sent.

bodyBytes.description: Received response-body bytes, excluding headers and transport overhead; not a carrier billing measurement.

post.summary: Run, cancel, or reset the keepalive baseline
post.description: The body must be empty. Run uses the saved action even if automatic scheduling is disabled. Data keepalive needs ML307A, home registration, valid time, and an HTTP or HTTPS download URL. HTTP is an unencrypted public GET without credentials, custom headers, or a body. It does not use a CA. HTTPS requires its provisioned origin CA and certificate verification. Each response allows a 64 KiB body and separate 4 KiB headers. A job has eight requests and a two-minute request budget plus bounded cleanup. Redirects and chunked responses are rejected. Cancellation stops before the next request. An in-flight request finishes cleanup. Reset changes only the baseline and requires synchronized time. Existing SMS/USSD actions and maintenance notices retain their behavior. Transfer volume is an estimate, not carrier billing or a guarantee of extended SIM validity.

200.description: Admission or reset result; inspect success and message, then poll GET for terminal job outcome.

post.summary: Validate and preview forwarding rules without delivery
post.description: Uses the same POSIX matcher as forwarding. The first active match determines the result. No match uses the default enabled channels. The request never saves settings, sends messages, or logs input text. The worker shares the bounded job queue. A failed result has detail line:reason, where CSV line numbers exclude the storage marker. Successful result data contains matched, line (0 for no match), drop, email, and channelMask (bits 0-4). These are selected actions, not a delivery guarantee. The form body is limited to 16384 bytes and three fields.

rules.description: Exact stored rules. CSV v1 has the prefix #!forward-rules-csv-v1 followed by LF. Unmarked text retains legacy Tab semantics.

429.description: The bounded job queue is full.

get.summary: Get the management page from the tools alias
Get the management page from the messaging alias
Get the device state and configuration
get.description: SMTP, management account, and WiFi password values are empty strings in this response. Forwarding rules are returned exactly so they can be edited without changing multiline, tab, or UTF-8 content.

get.summary: Get eSIM structural status and masked profiles
get.description: Returns EID structural metadata and opaque profile handles. ICCID, ISD-P AID, EID, network identifiers, server addresses, and modem identifiers never appear. During authenticated installation consent, bounded profile and provider display names are included. The response is not cached.

405.description: Only GET and POST are supported.

post.description: Queues profile actions or installation without automatically enabling the installed profile. Profile mutations require a current opaque handle. Install accepts exactly action and activationCode. After authenticated profile details are available, confirm accepts exactly action, jobId, accepted (true or false), and confirmationCode only when accepted=true and the carrier requires a code. Consent is required even without a carrier code. accepted=false postpones the installation without terminating the carrier order. Confirmation expires after at most five minutes without status polling. The form-encoded body is limited to 2048 bytes and four fields. Codes stay in memory and are never logged or returned. Poll GET /api/esim for the exact accepted job ID, not /api/jobs. One job is retained until the next job or reboot. Installation uses bounded phases without an overall job TTL. Installed profiles with pending notification report success with ACTION_ESIM_NOTIFICATION_PENDING. Uncertain installation or cancellation failure must not trigger automatic activation-code reuse. Only ordinary three-field activation codes and profiles without policy-rule restrictions are supported.

409.description: The device is busy, the profile handle is stale, or confirmation does not match an active pending installation.

post.description: The request can contain one configuration section. forwardRules is saved as exact multiline, tab, and UTF-8 text after the existing 2048-byte and enabled regular-expression validation. emailEnabled and pushEnabled use explicit 0 or 1 values, and each can be updated alone without changing credentials or per-channel settings. A blank account username disables that account. Blank account passwords and blank WiFi passwords for unchanged secured SSIDs keep their stored values. A non-empty WiFi password must contain 8 to 63 printable ASCII characters. Changing a WiFi SSID or converting an open profile to secured requires a new password or the explicit wifiNopen field; an empty SSID disables the profile and clears its password. Blank or omitted push url, key1, key2, and custom body fields retain stored values only when the provider type is unchanged; changing the provider type clears all four stored fields before applying non-empty replacements. Requests containing only one channel's cellularEnabled, cellularUrl, or cellularUrlClear preserve its enabled state and provider settings. Ordinary provider saves still disable the channel when en is omitted. At least one usable account must remain. A present empty smtpPass clears the SMTP password. Validation completes before persistence and a rejected request does not change configuration.
The device splits long content into multipart SMS messages. One request can contain at most 255 encoded parts.
The route is retained for client compatibility and completes with ACTION_PING_UNSUPPORTED. The device does not access the cellular modem or enable a PDP context.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Return entries older than this entry id. Omit or use zero for the latest page.

200.description: A cursor page in chronological order.

post.description: Requests one planned whole-device restart. The request body must be empty. The device authenticates and checks the POST CSRF token before body validation, then returns 409 when a backup transfer, OTA, device or restore restart, API job, or push test is active. This direct action uses 200 OK because it has no queued API job or job ID; the delayed restart task powers off the modem before esp_restart.

200.description: The restart was admitted and will occur after a short delay.

400.description: The request body is not empty.

403.description: The POST CSRF token is missing or invalid.

409.description: Another transfer, job, push test, or planned restart is active.

200.description: The job state and final action result.

404.description: The job does not exist or expired.

get.summary: Read a bounded authenticated crash summary
get.description: Returns only reset classification and a bounded, validated core-dump summary. The route requires Basic Auth, accepts no request body, does not require CSRF, never returns raw core bytes, previous logs, registers, task control blocks, stack bytes, credentials, or modem data, and does not erase the core dump.

200.description: A valid or absent core-dump summary.

400.description: The GET request included a body.

500.description: The core dump is invalid, unavailable, or cannot be summarized without exposing raw data.

get.summary: Get one push channel test status
get.description: Without detail=1, the response is the legacy exact five-key status shape. With detail=1, terminal responses may add bounded cleanupMessage, failureReason, failureResponseReason, cleanupReason, failureParseReason, cleanupParseReason, failureParseShape, cleanupParseShape, resetNeeded, transportPath, dispatchAttempted, failureStage, and httpStatus fields; active responses never add diagnostic fields. Unknown, duplicate, or invalid query fields are rejected.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Set to 1 to opt in to bounded terminal diagnostic detail.

200.description: The bounded per-channel test status. Provider credentials are never returned.

post.description: Queues one test against the selected saved channel configuration. The request body must be empty, and the route never accepts or returns provider credentials. Without detail=1, responses are the legacy exact five-key status shape. With detail=1, terminal responses may add bounded cleanupMessage, failureReason, failureResponseReason, cleanupReason, failureParseReason, cleanupParseReason, failureParseShape, cleanupParseShape, resetNeeded, transportPath, dispatchAttempted, failureStage, and httpStatus fields; active responses never add diagnostic fields. Unknown, duplicate, or invalid query fields are rejected. A duplicate active channel, another mutation, an incomplete channel, unavailable WiFi, or unsupported cellular-only mode fails closed; cellular data is never enabled. A queued test that cannot start becomes a terminal timeout result after 60 seconds.

parameters.description: Set to 1 to opt in to bounded terminal diagnostic detail.

get.description: Returns the running app slot and image validity, accepted and pending replay metadata, and the SHA-256 identity of the embedded OTA public key. The route is read-only, requires Basic Auth, does not require CSRF, rejects a non-empty request body, and never returns firmware, NVS contents, credentials, or private key material.

500.description: The running image or OTA metadata could not be read.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: The token from GET /api/config. Required for state-changing requests.

ManagementPage.description: The same production HTML that the ESP32-C3 serves.

Content-Encoding.description: The firmware sends gzip. The mock server can send an uncompressed response.

InputTooLong.description: Invalid bounded input. ACTION_INPUT_TOO_LONG and ACTION_INPUT_INVALID leave configuration unchanged and detail contains only the field name; the AT route can instead return ACTION_AT_REJECTED for unsafe command classes.

BodyTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds 16384 bytes. The server closes the connection and does not cache the response.

ModemBusy.description: The modem is processing another transaction.

JsonSerializationFailure.description: The device could not serialize the resource response.

UploadStarted.description: The upload session started. The response contains uploadId, chunkSize, and nextOffset.

UploadChunk.description: The chunk was accepted. The response contains nextOffset.

JobAccepted.description: The bounded background job was accepted. The response contains jobId.

code.description: Stable code translated by the frontend. Firmware and mock server expose the same set. The retained /ping route completes with ACTION_PING_UNSUPPORTED; older ping result codes remain only for compatibility.

detail.description: Raw diagnostic text for failures. For ACTION_INPUT_TOO_LONG and ACTION_INPUT_INVALID it contains only the field name; otherwise it is empty when code and data are sufficient.

ActionData.description: Structured operation output. Fields are present only when relevant to the requested action.

previewEngine.description: Present only on mock-server preview results. Device results use the runtime POSIX engine and omit this field.

handle.description: Opaque profile selector issued by GET /api/esim.

jobId.description: Exact current installation job ID, at most 4294967295.

confirmationRequired.description: Whether the carrier requires a confirmation code. Consent is requested by running state and awaiting_confirmation stage even when this is false.

PushTestParseShape.description: Bounded parser structural metadata with no payload or raw response values. fieldCount 8 represents 8 or more fields; quoteMask bits 0 through 7 indicate quoted CSV fields; presenceMask bits are MIPSTATE=1, MIPOPEN=2, MIPCLOSE=4, MIPURC=8, and other=16; responseTraceMask bits are echo=1, OK=2, valid rtcp=4, MIPRD prefix=8, valid disconnect=16, OK-before-rtcp=32, and rtcp-before-OK=64; rtcp lengths are bounded to 65536 and meaningful only when valid rtcp is present; lineClass distinguishes missing, unexpected, duplicate, and extra lines; singleFieldClass is classified only for one CSV field.

PushTestStatus.description: Exactly one lifecycle shape applies: idle, queued, running, succeeded, or failed. Success is true only for a completed successful test.

open.description: True when the SSID is enabled and its stored password is empty.

urlSet.description: True when a URL is stored for the current provider type.

cellularEnabled.description: False permanently blocks this channel from cellular delivery.

cellularUrlSet.description: True when a sensitive cellular URL override is stored. The URL itself is never returned.

key1Set.description: True when key1 is stored for the current provider type.

key2Set.description: True when key2 is stored for the current provider type.

customBodySet.description: True when a custom body is stored for the current provider type.

emailEnabled.description: Global email delivery switch. SMTP credentials remain configured while this is false.

pushEnabled.description: Global push delivery switch. Per-channel enabled values and credentials remain configured while this is false.

forwardRules.description: Exact saved rule text. This editor field is not masked; credential fields remain redacted separately.

networkMode.description: 0 selects WiFi only, 1 selects 4G only, and 2 prefers WiFi with cellular fallback. Cellular delivery requires an enabled per-channel cellular target and an installed device-validated CA. Cellular GET uses the same HTTPS, CA, clock, home-registration, cleanup, and 2xx gates as POST; it accepts no body, keeps the fixed GET method, limits rendered URLs to 4096 bytes, keeps POST URLs at 240 bytes and POST bodies at 4096 bytes, rejects HTTP downgrade, and preserves existing response-parser limits. ML307Y cellular transport is disabled and roaming fails closed.

kaTrafficKB.description: Stored values up to 10000 KiB are preserved. Data keepalive accepts at most 512 KiB at runtime. Body bytes estimate transfer volume, not carrier billing.
Values above 512 KiB can remain stored while disabled but cannot run or enable data keepalive.

kaUrl.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS download URL for data keepalive. HTTP is unencrypted and does not use a CA. HTTPS retains origin-bound certificate verification. Login credentials, control characters, and fragments are rejected. URLs must not contain sensitive information. No automatic scheme, host, or schedule migration occurs.

^push[0-4]url$.description: Blank or omitted retains the stored URL when the provider type is unchanged.

^push[0-4]cellularUrl$.description: Sensitive override. Blank or omitted preserves the stored value.

^push[0-4]cellularUrlClear$.description: Explicitly clears the stored override. It is invalid with a nonempty cellularUrl in the same request.

^push[0-4]key[12]$.description: Blank or omitted retains the stored key when the provider type is unchanged.

^push[0-4]body$.description: Blank or omitted retains the stored custom body when the provider type is unchanged.
